title: Crypto-Checker: Multi-Threaded Cross-Chain Wallet Auditor
excerpt: Explore Crypto-Checker, a Python multi-threaded tool for auditing wallets across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and other chains. Learn about its features, ethical considerations, and rising demand for cross-chain security analysis.
description: Crypto-Checker: Python tool for multi-threaded wallet auditing on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and EVM. Proxy rotation, USD valuation, ethical analysis.
